title: The Options API, because existing code is full of it

videos.script:
Everything so far was written in the Composition API. But the first Vue code you are paid to change will probably be written the other way. {{options}} The Options API. A component as an object, with data, computed, methods and mounted, each in its own box.

You will see one card written both ways, side by side, behaving exactly the same. {{this}} Then the bug that only the Options API has. A method written as an arrow function, and a this that is not the component.

{{hooks}} Then the lifecycle by its old names, created and mounted, and a surprise about this dot el. {{watch}} Then the watch option, and the change that broke array watchers when people upgraded to Vue three.

{{mixins}} Then mixins. Two of them, written a year apart, collide on one word, and nothing warns.

{{mixing}} And last, both APIs in one component, which is how an old codebase moves across a piece at a time.
